credibility.line: Management walked back capacity and cost targets mid-year as FY26 plunged to a 2,394 crore rupee loss.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Q4 FY26 income claimed at 238 billion rupees matches reported 22,438 crore rupees revenue, though PAT reached -2,537 crore.
Q1 FY27 revenue grew 19.9% to 24,584 crore rupees as claimed, but net loss landed at 238 crore rupees.
Q2 FY27 revenue rose 25.9% YoY to 23,364 crore rupees, though company reported a net loss of 1,879 crore rupees.

bull: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 25.9% YoY to 23,364 crore rupees on strong passenger yields.
Strong 5-year operating cash conversion of 1274% of profit with 23,470 crore rupees OCF in FY26.
Guidance holds for early double-digit to mid-teens capacity growth from FY28 to FY30.
bear: Full year FY26 profitability swung from 7,258 crore rupees PAT in FY25 to a 2,394 crore rupee loss.
Leveraged balance sheet pushed D/E ratio to 17.47 in Sep 2026 with 87,303 crore rupees of borrowings.
Company posted consecutive net losses in Mar 2026 (-2,537 crore), Jun 2026 (-238 crore), and Sep 2026 (-1,879 crore).
watch: Profitability recovery in Q3 FY27 after three straight loss quarters.
Borrowings trajectory relative to the 87,303 crore rupees reported in Sep 2026.
Full year FY27 capacity growth against the single-digit guidance.
